verdict.rationale: Buzz is open source and self-hostable as a single relay or via a Helm chart. Messages are stored in your own PostgreSQL/S3 backend with no external services required, which implies a team can run it at no license cost and keep its own history. Agents are described searching six months of history. However, nothing in the evidence documents pricing tiers or history-retention limits, so the no-loss-of-history claim is only inferred. Missing for 10: any documented free tier or pricing plan for hosted Buzz, an explicit statement that message history is unlimited or retained indefinitely, and independent or hands-on confirmation of long-term history access.
